mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 70 degrees with overcast skies by the Verona Area High School, a Waning Gibbous moon, an overnight low of 63 degrees, and no rain in the forecast.

The city has two important updates for you. First, road surface treatments begin August 4 on Lincoln Street, so look for parking restrictions. Second, the city is offering a 100 dollar rebate for residents who install water-efficient toilets.

There is a lot going on today! We have the Remote Area Medical clinic at Verona Area High School, the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree at Seven Acre Dairy, plus various live music performances across our local venues.
For our weekly report, we noted an incident on Saturday, July 26, involving an O W I arrest after a vehicle was stopped for traveling 97 miles per hour on the highway.

Today's featured flavor is the decadent Chocolate Volcano, and you have plenty of time to get one before Culver's closes at 10:30 PM. Also, be sure to visit the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park today from 1:30 PM to 3:15 PM.
